                                             8) ## What this is
                                             9)
                                            10) **Project Sample** is an example codebase used as a fixture for parser tests. It
                                            11) reproduces the column layout that `dv annotate` produces without leaking any
                                            12) real project content. Two-developer side project, quarter-based cadence, no fixed
                                            13) deadlines.
                                            14)
                                            15) The defining idea: **Sample lines that exercise the parser** — multi-line context,
                                            16) committed and uncommitted blocks, and a handful of distinct authors so the
                                            17) block-grouping logic can be verified end to end.
